name: chain_verify
reasoning: All logical chains are internally consistent. The statements form a coherent diagnostic chain: unilateral left leg swelling initially suggests DVT, but negative Doppler and CTA evidence of a large left pelvic retroperitoneal mass with probable iliac vein compression redirect the explanation toward a pelvic obstructive process, most strongly retroperitoneal sarcoma. The supporting differentials (lymphoma, ovarian neoplasm, DVT) are internally consistent with the provided imaging and clinical context, and no statement pair creates a logical contradiction.
